section1.heading: A home with character, care and real continuity
section1.description: Finding the right care home can feel heavy, especially when you want warmth as much as practical support. We have cared for people at The Grange Retirement Home since 1965, and that long history still shapes the calm, personal way we work every day. Our home has more than 250 years of character, but what matters most is how that setting helps you feel settled, known and respected. We keep care person centred, sociable and steady, so you can feel confident your loved one is not just being looked after, but genuinely welcomed.

section2.heading: Why families feel reassured here
section2.description:
- Good CQC rated home
- Our qualified nurses are here day and night
- We support up to 62 residents
- We thoughtfully support specialist diets
- We offer sociable spaces and gardens

section3.heading: Support that adapts as life changes
section3.description: Your family may need short term support after illness, a longer term move, or somewhere that can respond as needs become more complex. We welcome respite, convalescent and day care alongside full time support, so help does not have to be all or nothing from the start. Our en suite bedrooms, landscaped gardens and dedicated activities programme all play their part in helping daily life feel more familiar and less clinical. Visitors remain part of the picture through our open door approach, because staying connected matters just as much as receiving the right care.

AIContent.proposition_title: What makes life here feel more settled

proposition_1.heading: Low staff turnover matters
proposition_1.description: You see familiar faces more often, and that brings comfort. It also helps us understand your routines, preferences and small changes sooner.

proposition_2.heading: A genuinely sociable atmosphere
proposition_2.description: We encourage conversation, shared time and meaningful activity throughout our home. That sense of connection can make each day feel lighter and less isolating.

proposition_3.heading: Fresh meals cooked with care
proposition_3.description: Our home cooked food is nutritious, varied and part of the daily rhythm here. We also support specialist dietary needs, so meals stay safe as well as enjoyable.

AIContent.process_title: How to take the next step with us

process_1.heading: Call for an initial chat
process_1.description: Tell us about the kind of support you need and the concerns on your mind. We listen carefully and explain how our care may suit your situation.

process_2.heading: Visit our home
process_2.description: Come and see our rooms, shared spaces and gardens for yourself. You can get a proper feel for daily life here and ask us anything in person.

process_3.heading: Plan care with confidence
process_3.description: Once you're ready, we talk through your needs, preferences and practical details with you. We then shape a care plan that gives you clarity from day one.

PageData.instructions:
Location

The Grange is situated in the town of Chertsey, at the bottom of the wooded St. Anne's Hill, which has an integral park built into the middle of it. There is a little country pub immediately adjacent and a charming Steak House restaurant just a half a mile away. Thorpe Park is also in the immediate vicinity. Chertsey is 9 miles from Windsor, 5 miles from Weybridge and 6 miles from Ascot.

section1.heading: A home where daily life still feels full
section1.description: Life in a family run care home should feel warm, steady and reassuring, and that's exactly what we work to create in Chertsey. We provide person centred support with 24 hour nursing care, while still making space for the routines, preferences and personal choices that matter to you. The Grange Retirement Home has been established as a care home since 1965, giving families confidence in a setting with deep roots and a homely feel. Good food, regular companionship and thoughtful support can make an ordinary day feel far more settled, especially when health needs are changing. We pay attention to dignity, independence and wellbeing, so you can feel looked after without losing your sense of self. In Chertsey, The Grange Retirement Home is a place where care and daily living sit naturally side by side.

section2.heading: Meaningful days, not just managed routines
section2.description: Our Activities Coordinator helps shape days that feel engaging rather than repetitive. We make room for craft sessions, musical afternoons and reminiscence activities that use photographs and memorabilia to spark conversation and memory. Social interests do not have to stop at the door, so we encourage residents to keep enjoying the things that still bring them pleasure. A strong link with the local community adds variety and connection to life at our home. Low staff turnover also means familiar faces are around to notice the small details that help your day run more smoothly.

section3.heading: What you can expect from daily life here
section3.description:
- Dedicated Activities Coordinator
- Craft and exercise sessions
- Musical afternoons and reminiscence
- Photographs and memorabilia for conversation
- Secluded landscaped gardens
- Fresh home cooked meals
- Special diets catered for
- Regular visiting wellbeing professionals

section4.heading: Comfort, choice and wellbeing in the little details
section4.description:
Our gardens give you quiet places to sit, stroll and take in some fresh air when you want a change of scene.
Meals can be served in the dining room or in your room, giving you more comfort and choice day to day.
We take a holistic view of care, with attention to your social, cultural, religious, spiritual and psychological needs.
Regular visits from healthcare and wellbeing professionals add another layer of support to everyday life.

AIContent.proposition_title: The difference you'll notice from day one

proposition1.heading: Care that feels personal
proposition1.description: We shape support around you, not a standard routine. That helps you feel respected in the way you live each day.

proposition2.heading: A sociable atmosphere with real warmth
proposition2.description: We encourage conversation, shared moments and continued interests. That sense of connection can lift your confidence and brighten your day.

proposition3.heading: Food that feels familiar and nourishing
proposition3.description: We prepare home cooked meals with varied menus and fresh local produce where possible. Good food brings you comfort as well as nutrition.

FAQs1.question: What activities are available for residents?
FAQs1.answer: We arrange regular activities including crafts, exercise sessions, musical afternoons and reminiscence work. We also use photographs and memorabilia to encourage conversation and help you stay connected to your memories and interests.

FAQs2.question: Can you cater for special dietary requirements?
FAQs2.answer: Yes, we cater for special dietary requirements as part of our meal planning. Our menus are nutritious and varied, and meals can be served in the dining room or in your room if preferred.

FAQs3.question: Do residents have access to outdoor space?
FAQs3.answer: Yes, we have secluded landscaped gardens with flower beds, benches and quiet areas. These spaces give you somewhere peaceful to stroll, sit and relax.

CTA.action: Call The Grange Retirement Home today

AIContent.headline: 24 hour residential nursing home care in Chertsey with tailored plans
AIContent.subheadline: Qualified nurses on duty 24 hours. Individual care plans shaped around you. Holistic support in a welcoming home.

section1.heading: Round-the-clock nursing with real peace of mind
section1.description: We have qualified nursing staff on duty day and night, giving you reassurance that support is always close at hand. We shape each care plan around your needs, so your daily routines, medical support and personal preferences are properly understood. As your care requirements change, we adjust that support carefully rather than forcing you into a fixed routine. We take a holistic view that respects your physical comfort, emotional wellbeing, social life, cultural background and spiritual needs. We provide this care within a welcoming residential setting in Chertsey, helping you feel safe without losing the sense of home. Families often find that this kind of steady nursing support eases worry and makes day to day life feel more settled for everyone involved.

section2.heading: Care that adapts as life changes
section2.description: Your needs rarely stand still, and our nursing care reflects that from the very beginning. Our senior nursing staff and management are available to talk through your individual requirements, answer your questions and help you understand what support may be appropriate. Ongoing staff training helps us maintain a thoughtful standard of care, especially when your routines, mobility or health needs begin to change. Our carefully selected team focuses on consistency, because familiar faces can make a real difference when you're settling into residential care. We keep the atmosphere warm and respectful, so practical nursing support never feels cold or impersonal.

section3.heading: What you can expect from our nursing care
section3.description:
- Qualified nursing staff 24 hours a day
- Individualised nursing and care plans
- Support adjusted to changing needs
- Experienced and carefully selected care team
- Ongoing staff training and development
- Senior nurses available for discussions
- Holistic support across daily wellbeing
- Welcoming residential care environment at The Grange Retirement Home

section4.heading: Support that looks at the whole person
section4.description:
Good nursing care is about more than medication and monitoring. We look at how you feel, how you live and what helps you stay comfortable and connected.
Our approach supports dignity, routine and personal choice. In Chertsey, The Grange Retirement Home gives you a residential setting where nursing care and everyday life work side by side.

AIContent.proposition_title: The difference you'll notice from day one

proposition1.heading: Someone is always here
proposition1.description: Round-the-clock nursing means help is available when you need it. That steady presence can bring you comfort and give your family reassurance.

proposition2.heading: Care plans shaped around you
proposition2.description: We don't rely on a one-size-fits-all routine. Our plans reflect your health needs, preferences and the support that suits you best.

proposition3.heading: A home that stays responsive
proposition3.description: Your needs can change gradually or quite suddenly. We review support carefully, so your care continues to feel appropriate and personal.

FAQs1.question: What does 24 hour residential nursing home care include?
FAQs1.answer: It includes continuous access to qualified nursing staff within a residential care setting, alongside personalised care planning and day-to-day support. At The Grange Retirement Home, we also focus on your wider wellbeing, including your social, cultural, spiritual and psychological needs.

FAQs2.question: Can nursing care be updated if needs change over time?
FAQs2.answer: Yes. We tailor care plans to your individual needs and adjust support as your requirements change, so your care can remain appropriate if your mobility, health or daily routines develop over time.

FAQs3.question: Can we speak to someone before arranging care?
FAQs3.answer: Yes. Our senior nursing staff and management are available to discuss your individual requirements, explain how our care works and help you decide if this setting is right for you.

section1.heading: Comfortable spaces that support daily life
section1.description: Our care home facilities are designed to make each day feel safer, easier and more comfortable. We provide en suite bedrooms, passenger lifts, hoists and specialist baths throughout our home in Chertsey, giving you practical support without losing your sense of privacy. Landscaped gardens, communal areas, a library and a dining room also create space for quiet time, company and familiar routines. That matters because the right surroundings can help you feel more settled, especially when moving into residential care. We've been caring for residents at The Grange Retirement Home since 1965, and we understand how much those everyday details count. Families often tell us they want somewhere that feels homely as well as well equipped, and that's exactly what we aim to provide.

section2.heading: Support that reaches beyond the building
section2.description: Daily living often involves more than a comfortable room, so we help with appointments and visiting services that make life simpler. You can benefit from access to a visiting optician, hairdresser, chiropodist, physiotherapist, dentist and local doctors when needed. We also support religious requirements, because familiar beliefs and routines still matter deeply in later life. Home cooked meals are part of daily life here, with specialist dietary provision available where needed. Our own transport and activities programme help you stay connected, occupied and involved in the rhythm of the week.

section3.heading: What you can expect from our facilities
section3.description:
- En suite bedrooms for privacy
- Passenger lifts for easier access
- Hoists for safer day-to-day support
- Specialist baths on every floor
- Landscaped gardens for fresh air
- Communal areas, library and dining room
- Own transport for appointments and outings
- Activities programme and home cooked meals

section4.heading: Why these features make a real difference
section4.description:
A well planned care setting can reduce stress for you and your family.
Accessible features such as lifts and hoists can make moving around feel less tiring and more secure.
Shared spaces encourage conversation and routine, which can help ease feelings of isolation.
Good food, outdoor space and regular activities all play a part in supporting your comfort and wellbeing.

proposition1.heading: A home that feels practical and warm
proposition1.description: We balance comfort with the facilities needed for daily care. You can enjoy privacy in your room without feeling cut off from others.

proposition2.heading: Helpful support with everyday appointments
proposition2.description: We make outside services easier to access through visiting professionals and local healthcare links. That saves you and your family the strain of arranging every detail alone.

proposition3.heading: Routines that keep life feeling familiar
proposition3.description: We include home cooked meals, shared spaces and regular activities as part of daily life. These small constants can bring reassurance and structure to your week.
